title: We're developing VANDREM, a multiplayer zombie survival game where the city has all the loot, but you have to build your home outside it.
author: Known-Translator8000
selftext:
Hey everyone!

We're developing VANDREM, a third-person open-world multiplayer zombie survival game in Unreal Engine 5.

AI has been used to shape the way zombies think, and to create modern environments in which players forge their own stories.  
The main idea is to make every trip into the city feel like a risk worth thinking about. You need food, medicine, weapons and materials, but the city is overrun by zombies, and building inside it is not allowed.

Instead, players establish their bases outside the city and venture into dangerous areas to gather supplies.

[https://discord.gg/8hxDafQnS](https://discord.gg/8hxDafQnS)

Some of the core mechanics we're working on:

* Hunger, thirst and exhaustion.
* Inventory weight affecting movement.
* Persistent base building and crafting.
* Zombies reacting to noise.
* Dormant zombies that can be disturbed by players.
* Dark nights with more dangerous infected.
* Online multiplayer with dedicated servers.

The footage is from our early development build, not a cinematic render. There's still a lot of work ahead, and the visuals, animations and gameplay will continue to evolve.

I'd love to hear what experienced survival players think:

What makes scavenging genuinely tense for you? Limited ammunition, unpredictable zombie behaviour, resource scarcity, or something else?

We're still early enough in development to experiment with these mechanics, so your feedback would be valuable.

Thanks for checking out our project!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Known-Translator8000 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.
